fit_score.note: bbox-normalised 96x96 mask IoU vs the product photo (check-asset.js); the shield outline itself is from Fig A7-4, so a lower IoU than the old photo-averaged shape is expected

notes: Geometry is script-generated; parameters live in the generator tables. Shield outline measured from CAPR 39-1 Figure A7-4 (enamel/measure-shield-reg.js, 15 technician shields); the triangle, seal and letters come from the product photo. The rim is one flat silver (#bcc1c6) of one width all round, 1.75 % of the shield's width (the photographs show 1.71 % over 48 of them, enamel/measure-ref-rim.js), and the enamel field one flat colour, no shadow (LIVE13-ART 58); the art box is measured on the art as drawn, the whole shield inside it. One enamel field and one set of emblem colours for the whole family at every level, the median of the family's photographs (enamel/family-colour.js, enamel/measure-family-colour.js; LIVE13-ART 63). The level device is centred on the shield's axis (LIVE13-ART 64).
